verdict.rationale: The README says that after installation you can 'start a new session and ask for a logo; the agent picks the skill up from its description.' The skill uses the SKILL.md Agent Skills format, so it triggers automatically from task context. That is a single first-party line, though, and nothing shows how the description is written or tested to fire at the right moment. missing for 10: the actual SKILL.md description text or trigger-design rationale, evidence of precision against false or missed activations, independent or hands-on corroboration of auto-triggering.
